content.text: The log identifies the root cause: after publishing to the external submodule repository, the job commits its updated gitlink and directly pushes that commit to protected `main`. I’m locating that workflow now; the check will be that no workflow step retains `HEAD:main` for the parent repository.

The existing design explicitly promises a pointer bump, so simply removing it would leave the repository out of sync. I’ll retain that behavior by pushing the gitlink update to an automation branch and opening a PR, then align the documentation with the new protected-branch flow.

I’m changing the pointer update into a dedicated automation branch plus pull request, authenticated with the existing `RELEASE_PAT` when present so the PR’s checks can run. This preserves branch protection and lets coverage and CodeQL gate the merge normally.
